name: Telegram 客户端
description: 在侧栏里用手机号登录自己的 Telegram 账号，像官方客户端一样聊天：会话列表与聊天分组、论坛话题、实时收发、相册、边下边播视频、表情与贴纸面板、编辑、回复、表情回应、已读详情、切换发言身份、机器人按钮与键盘、新消息系统通知；附带 Agent 工具，可查聊天、读写消息、订阅新消息。支持 socks5 与 MTProxy 代理。

configuration.title: 代理（可选）
configuration.description: socks5://127.0.0.1:7890、socks5://user:pass@host:port，或 MTProxy 链接 tg://proxy?server=…&port=…&secret=…；修改后打开侧栏会自动重连

configuration.title: 新消息系统通知
configuration.description: 未静音的聊天收到新消息时弹系统通知；正在看的聊天不提醒

agentTools.name: tg_current_chat
agentTools.description: Get the chat the user currently has open in the Telegram sidebar (id, title, type, forum topic, whether the sidebar is visible) plus its latest messages. Use when the user says "this chat", "the current group", etc. Returns open:false with lastOpened when the sidebar is closed or no chat is open.

limit.description: Recent messages to include, default 10, max 50, 0 for none

agentTools.name: tg_list_chats
agentTools.description: List the user's Telegram chats (most recent first) with id, title, type, unread/mention counts, muted flag and last message preview. Requires the user to be logged in via the Telegram sidebar.

unreadOnly.description: Only chats with unread messages or mentions

agentTools.name: tg_search_chats
agentTools.description: Search Telegram chats, contacts, groups and public channels by name or @username. Returns id, title, type, username and whether the user has joined.

agentTools.name: tg_list_topics
agentTools.description: List topics of a forum group (chats with topics), most recent first: id, title, unread/mention counts, pinned, closed, last message. Use the topic id with tg_get_messages / tg_send_message.

chat.description: Chat id, @username, t.me link, or chat title Omit to use the chat currently open in the Telegram sidebar.

agentTools.name: tg_get_messages
agentTools.description: Read recent messages of a Telegram chat, oldest first. Each message has id, time, sender, text, media summary, replyTo, reactions, and topic/topicTitle in forum groups. Does not mark the chat as read. Pass olderBefore from the result as `before` to page back.

chat.description: Chat id (from tg_list_chats / tg_search_chats), @username, t.me link, exact or partial chat title, or "me" for Saved Messages Omit to use the chat currently open in the Telegram sidebar.

before.description: Only messages with id lower than this

topic.description: Optional forum topic id (from tg_list_topics; 1 = General); omit to read all topics mixed; when chat is omitted, defaults to the topic open in the sidebar

agentTools.name: tg_search_messages
agentTools.description: Full-text search Telegram messages, within one chat or across all chats (newest first). Global results include chat id and title.

chat.description: Optional; omit to search all chats. Chat id (from tg_list_chats / tg_search_chats), @username, t.me link, exact or partial chat title, or "me" for Saved Messages

agentTools.name: tg_send_message
agentTools.description: Send a text message as the user's own Telegram account. Only send when the user explicitly asked to, to the chat they meant. Supports Telegram markdown (**bold**, __italic__, `code`, [text](url)). If chat is omitted it goes to the chat open in the sidebar — confirm which chat that is (tg_current_chat) unless the user clearly meant it.

chat.description: Chat id (from tg_list_chats / tg_search_chats), @username, t.me link, exact or partial chat title, or "me" for Saved Messages Omit to use the chat currently open in the Telegram sidebar.

replyTo.description: Optional message id to reply to

topic.description: Forum topic id to post in (from tg_list_topics; 1 or omitted = General); when chat is omitted, defaults to the topic open in the sidebar

agentTools.name: tg_mark_read
agentTools.description: Mark all messages in a Telegram chat as read.

chat.description: Chat id (from tg_list_chats / tg_search_chats), @username, t.me link, exact or partial chat title, or "me" for Saved Messages Omit to use the chat currently open in the Telegram sidebar.

agentTools.name: tg_wait_messages
agentTools.description: Block until new incoming Telegram messages arrive (long poll), then return them. Watches one chat, or all unmuted chats if chat is omitted. Pass the returned cursor to the next call so no message is missed between calls. Returns timeout:true if nothing arrived.

chat.description: Optional; omit for all unmuted chats. Chat id, @username, t.me link, or chat title

directOnly.description: Only private chats, @mentions of the user and replies to the user

includeMuted.description: Also include muted chats (ignored when chat is given)

keywords.description: Optional; only messages containing any of these words (case-insensitive, max 20), plus messages that @mention or reply to the user

cursor.description: cursor from the previous tg_wait_messages result

agentTools.name: tg_watch
agentTools.description: Subscribe this session to new incoming Telegram messages: they are batched (~3s) and delivered into this conversation as a follow-up that starts a new turn, even while idle. One watch per session; calling again replaces it. Use tg_unwatch to stop. Requires the user to enable cross-session message delivery for this plugin in settings.

chat.description: Optional; omit for all unmuted chats. Chat id, @username, t.me link, or chat title
Chat id, @username, t.me link, or chat title

topic.description: Optional forum topic id for this chat only (1 = General)

chats.description: Optional; watch only these chats (max 20, same formats as chat). Takes precedence over chat; only messages from them are delivered instead of all unmuted chats. Use the object form { chat, topic } to filter one forum chat to a single topic while other chats keep every topic

topic.description: Optional forum topic id from tg_list_topics (1 = General). Requires exactly one chat; omit to receive every topic. Other topics in that chat are not delivered.

directOnly.description: Only private chats, @mentions of the user and replies to the user

includeMuted.description: Also include muted chats (ignored when chat is given)

keywords.description: Optional; only messages containing any of these words (case-insensitive, max 20), plus messages that @mention or reply to the user

debounceSec.description: Quiet period before the batch is delivered, 1-3600 seconds, default 3. Bursts within it are merged into one delivery (one agent turn)

minIntervalSec.description: Minimum gap between two deliveries, 0-86400 seconds (24h), default 0 (no throttling). Messages arriving in between merge into the next batch; use it when the chats are busy and waking the agent every few seconds is too much

note.description: Standing instruction repeated with every delivery, e.g. what to do with the messages

agentTools.name: tg_unwatch
agentTools.description: Stop the tg_watch subscription of this session.
